messages:
maria-ops: Hey team — noticed sustained backpressure on the structured-log-ingest queue for the last 30m. Grafana shows queue_depth spiking and we started dropping ~25% of JSON events. Impact: cost spikes and SLO noise. @ash-infra can you take a look? :eyes:

ash-infra: On it. seeing a pattern from gpu-telemetry shards in us-west-2. ingest pods scale but consumer lag stays high. probably high-cardinality fields in telemetry events (kv_cache_id/model_id/session_id).

benji-sre: Are alerts firing or just the dashboard? I saw alert floods earlier for log_pipeline_high_lag but they were severity P2.

maria-ops: Alerts did go off — got a stack of repeats. That's part of the problem: alert fatigue. We need smarter alerting + sampling.

samira-platform: Quick notes: 1) telemetry has new per-request metadata (prefix_kv keys) that increased cardinality 2) we recently doubled retention so ingest CPU went up.

ash-infra: I pulled a sample of recent events:
```
# sample from ingest pod logs
I 2026-03-18 14:05:12 queue_size=23456 drop_rate=0.25 shard=telemetry-gpu us-west-2 model=redwood-xl prefix_kv_keys=[session_123,cache_a,trace_x]
```
Lots of unique prefix_kv values per minute.

benji-sre: Proposed immediate mitigation: temporary adaptive sampling at the shard ingress to cut high-cardinality events by 90% while we triage. Also dampen alert frequency for existing lag alerts (auto-silence on repeated triggers for 10m).

maria-ops: Agreed. We should avoid blanket sampling that removes important eval signals. Suggest sample by (model, region) reservoir sampling with per-key caps. If model=platform-test we keep everything.

samira-platform: I can draft a sampling config. Rough config snippet:
```yaml
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.1
  overrides:
    - matcher: { resource: telemetry-gpu, region: us-west-2 }
      rate: 0.05
    - matcher: { tag: platform-test }
      rate: 1.0
  per_key_cap: 1000 # max events per minute per model/region combo
```

ash-infra: Nice. We'll implement as an ingress filter so dropped payloads never hit the heavy JSON path. Also add a lightweight hash-based reservoir sampler to keep diversity.

benji-sre: For alerts: change alerting rule from 'queue_depth > X for 1m' to 'queue_depth > X for 3m AND dropped_rate > 0.1 OR sustained_increase_in_cardinality'. Add a Grafana panel to show sampling rate by shard and approximate unique keys (hll estimate). That should reduce noise.

maria-ops: Can we also anonymize/remap high-cardinality keys to preserve schema while removing PII? E.g. map session ids -> <session_hash_prefix>. We must ensure compliance with redaction policy.

samira-platform: Yes — plan: two-pass pipeline. 1) Anonymize keys (stable hash with salt stored in KMS) 2) Apply sampling policy 3) JSON schema validation and routing. That keeps derived metrics usable but drops raw identifiers.

ash-infra: I'll open a canary rollout: apply ingress sampler to one pod in us-west-2 telemetry shard, route 5% traffic through it, and monitor queue depth / dropped rate / unique_keys metric.

deploy-bot: deploy started: ingress-sampler/us-west-2/canary (pod=ingress-5f2c) by ash-infra at 2026-03-18T14:22:10Z

benji-sre: While canary runs, I'll patch alert rules in staging and add a grace period so we don't get a delta on prod dashboards. Also add runbook entry for "ingest backpressure" with steps: diag queue, check unique_keys HLL, enable canary sampler, escalate to infra if canary drops <1% of useful traces.

maria-ops: Timeline: canary 14:22 -> 14:40, if queue_depth drops 50% and dropped_rate < 5% then ramp to 20% and update sampling rates. If we see regressions, rollback.

ash-infra: Canary metrics after 15m: queue_depth -42%, drop_rate -18% -> from 0.25 to 0.07, unique_keys_estimate -60%. Looks promising.

benji-sre: I tweaked alert threshold and silences in ops pager rotations. We'll keep a temporary runbook note to watch for missed eval regressions.

samira-platform: I'll prepare PR with sampling config, anonymization transform code, and test vectors. Also adding CI check: if a schema field is marked 'PII=true' then transform must be present upstream.

maria-ops: Heads up to privacy/compliance: we'll need a brief reviewing the hashing approach (salt lifecycle), please loop in @privacy. Also we must update the SLO dashboards to reflect sampled ingestion so per-token cost estimates remain accurate.

benji-sre: Postmortem-lite plan: after full rollout, we will run a one-week comparison of error rates on eval prompts and sampling coverage, and tune per-model rates.

maria-ops: Nice work. Action items: ash -> finish canary ramp and open deploy PR. samira -> PR for sampler + anonymizer. benji -> alert rule changes + runbook. I'll notify privacy and schedule a 30m sync after rollout results. :thumbsup:

alert-bot: Reminder: scheduled sync with privacy on 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z added to calendar (maria-ops, samira-platform, privacy-team).

maria-ops: Closing loop — canary ramped to 40% at 14:55, no regressions so far. We'll continue monitoring for 2 more hours then full roll. Thanks everyone. :green_heart:
